data.one_liner: WebRTC API wrapper for Dart, enabling browser-based audio/video communication.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart-friendly interface to the browser's WebRTC API, exposing peer connections, media streams, data channels, and E2EE support. It wraps the native JS objects using dart/js for cross-browser compatibility.
use_when: You need real-time audio/video or data communication in a Flutter web app.
You want to use WebRTC without writing JavaScript interop yourself.
You need E2EE or advanced media stream handling in the browser.
avoid_when: You are targeting mobile or desktop platforms only; this package is web-only.
You need a native WebRTC implementation for iOS/Android; use flutter-webrtc instead.
strengths: Pure Dart wrapper, no native plugins required.
Supports E2EE and advanced WebRTC features like priority control and data channel buffering.
Regularly updated with bug fixes and new browser support.
weaknesses: Web-only; not usable on mobile or desktop.
Requires manual compilation of the E2EE worker for wasm compatibility.
Relies on dart/js, so no type safety for all JS interop.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, no additional build steps needed.
